description: This file defines the MultipartUploader class within the Aws\Glacier namespace, which encapsulates functionality to manage multipart uploads to AWS Glacier, including creating uploads, resuming uploads from saved state, and handling part uploads with checksum calculations.

classes.name: MultipartUploader
classes.description: Handles multipart upload processes to AWS Glacier, including creation, resumption, part handling, and checksum management.

methods.name: getStateFromService
methods.description: Static method that retrieves and constructs an UploadState object by querying the Glacier service for existing upload parts, facilitating upload resumption.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MultipartUploader with a Glacier client, source data, and configuration options.

methods.name: loadUploadWorkflowInfo
methods.description: Returns configuration for the upload workflow commands such as initiate, upload, and complete.

methods.name: determinePartSize
methods.description: Calculates and validates the size of each part to be uploaded, ensuring compliance with AWS Glacier constraints.

methods.name: createPart
methods.description: Creates a data chunk from the source stream for upload, computing hashes concurrently.

methods.name: handleResult
methods.description: Updates the upload state after a part has been uploaded by marking it as completed with checksum details.

methods.name: getInitiateParams
methods.description: Prepares parameters required to initiate a multipart upload on Glacier.

methods.name: getCompleteParams
methods.description: Prepares parameters including size and checksum for completing the multipart upload.

methods.name: decorateWithHashes
methods.description: Wraps a stream with hashing streams to compute linear and tree hashes during upload.

methods.name: parseRange
methods.description: Parses a Glacier byte-range string into individual part index and size.
